title: Tracking metrics logical sources
summary: This iteration promotes OpenRouter Rankings, Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, and SWE-Bench Pro from unmapped collection entries into first-class logical sources under the fixed tracking_metrics section. It keeps the 154-entry inventory intact while reducing unmapped review candidates from 106 to 103.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source display contract governance|source insertion handbook|source order tuning review|source inventory order reference|tracking metrics logical sources" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Structured metric sources should be first-class in the source graph.
lessons.evidence: `openrouter-rankings`, `artificial-analysis-index`, and `swe-bench-pro` are now in `CORE_SOURCE_CONTRACTS` and `config/source-display-contract.json` under `tracking_metrics`.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the same small-batch promotion pattern for later high-confidence China model sources.

lessons.lesson: Promotion must update review and inventory references together.
lessons.evidence: `docs/source-inventory-order.md` now maps the three tracking entries to logical sources, and `docs/source-order-tuning-review.md` reduces unmapped sources to 103 and removes those promotion rows.
lessons.recommended_action: For every future promotion, update the executable contract, inventory reference, review surface, handbook, and tests in the same PR.

lessons.lesson: Tracking source identity should not change collection or template behavior.
lessons.evidence: This slice changes static logical-source metadata and deterministic generated HTML mapping text only; it leaves source registry, discovery, public JSON data, CSS/templates, automation, and publish behavior untouched.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep tracking component reconstruction and visual table behavior covered by existing tests when future metric sources are promoted.

followups.action: Promote the next small batch from `docs/source-order-tuning-review.md`, likely high-confidence `china_models` sources, after reviewing proposed ids and ranks.
